People of '''unknown affiliation''' are those whose allegiances are not mentioned in the books. It is mainly reserved for those Aes Sedai who cannot be sorted into the three main factions of [[Rebel Aes Sedai]], [[Elaida's White Tower]] and [[Unaligned Sisters]], but can be others who are not Aes Sedai.
